environment.vectorization: CountVectorizer with L2 row normalization (NOT TF-IDF; no IDF weighting)

benchmark.external_api: none (all data from MongoDB + local files)

aggregate.calculation_method: Pooled across all 200 raw individual runs (statistically correct, avoids quantile-of-quantiles error)

limitations: Vectorization uses CountVectorizer + L2 normalization, NOT TF-IDF (no IDF component).
All popularity scores in problems_meta.json are 0; popularity scoring dimension is inactive.
Solved-problem exclusion is verified only against stored problem slugs in MongoDB, not unrecorded live history.
fetchAcceptedSubmissions.js fails with HTTP 401 due to expired session cookie, leading to 0 stored slugs on refreshed profiles.
Weak-topic coverage (100%) measures retrieval filter alignment, not pedagogical accuracy or learning gains.
Precision@10 remains unmeasured pending independent human relevance judgments.
